title: Frappe ERPNext 7.0.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 7.0.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in the customer portal Projects list. This flaw allows authenticated users, including portal users or those without assigned roles, to access project costing and margin data by sending crafted requests for out-of-scope records. The vulnerability arises because the system returns all fields without verifying permissions on requested records.
